verifications.claim: Artemis II mission launched on April 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'blasted off from Florida on Wednesday evening'; URL: 2026/04/01. R4: 'Launch date April 1, 2026, 22:35:12 UTC'. R6: launch at 6:35 p.m. ET on April 1.
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the launch date as April 1, 2026.

verifications.claim: Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: All sources list exactly: Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, Jeremy Hansen.
verifications.reasoning: All references explicitly name these four as the Artemis II crew.

verifications.claim: Artemis II mission marks the first crewed flight to the Moon's vicinity in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'last time astronauts traveled that far was Apollo 17, in December 1972'; '54-year intermission'. R4: 'first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since Apollo 17 in 1972'.
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm first crewed lunar mission since Apollo 17 (1972), over 50 years.

verifications.claim: Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '10-day mission'. R2: 'approximately 10-day mission'. R4: '9 days, 1 hour... (approx 10)'.
verifications.reasoning: Consistently described as a 10-day mission across sources.

verifications.claim: Artemis II mission flies the Orion spacecraft.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: All sources: 'Orion spacecraft' for Artemis II.
verifications.reasoning: Every reference confirms Orion as the spacecraft.

verifications.claim: Artemis II mission includes the first woman to travel to the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Ms. Koch ... first woman to [venture into deep space]'. R3: 'first woman to fly on a moon-bound mission'.
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state Koch as first woman on lunar mission/deep space.

verifications.claim: Artemis II mission includes the first person of color to travel to the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Mr. Glover ... first Black man to venture into deep space'. R3: 'first Black astronaut ever to be sent on a lunar mission'.
verifications.reasoning: Glover identified as first Black/person of color on lunar mission.

verifications.reasoning: Hansen explicitly first Canadian/non-US on moon mission.
